grh_04438a9ed0bd8562fced.title: The Crown Jewels of Grandomir
paragraphs: Alfred Grant lives an ordinary American life while concealing from girlfriend Jill Gordon that he is the exiled king of tiny Grandomir. Three aging royalists still maintain a government-in-exile around him and dream of restoring him to the throne, while revolutionaries in Grandomir struggle with their own bankrupt regime and send agents to recover the royal crown jewels. Jill initially thinks Alfred's story is an elaborate joke until the exiles and the jewels prove otherwise. Alfred finally decides that he wants Jill and a private life more than a kingdom, and the couple swear that they will never claim the throne. A letter then arrives from Alfred's sister, who has already signed his abdication for him, overthrown the revolutionaries' arrangement by restoring the monarchy, and plans to crown herself queen. Relieved, Alfred and Jill celebrate while the old royalists transfer their loyalty to the new queen.

grh_04fecb3c6dddc8405eac.title: Vive Le Chance
paragraphs: Harry joins a Paris confidence scheme aimed at wealthy American traveler Henry Weatherstone. A young woman poses as the impoverished heir to a family treasure, and Harry's accomplices provide a planted jewel case, a fake government clerk and a map supposedly revealing where the ancestral fortune was buried. Harry and Weatherstone each put up a million francs to buy the case, then follow the map to an empty chest. Harry later learns that Weatherstone was running his own counter-swindle with the woman and tries to recover the money at gunpoint. He gets Weatherstone's million francs back, only to discover afterward that the woman has picked his pocket and taken it from him in turn.
